wording_dependence_pooled.reading: τ² is the between-frame variance of ι net of sampling variance, per rung, summarised over rungs; the classes are descriptive (module note) and select nothing

item2_frame_outliers.reading: leave-one-out: each frame's ι minus the mean of the other three, per rung; a systematic outlier keeps one sign and is the extreme far more often than chance; ties share the credit; descriptive only

spread_correlation_a_vs_b.reading: rank correlation of the cross-frame spread on A with the spread on B over rungs: a real frame effect reproduces the same large spreads on fresh topics; sampling noise does not

gate3_block.note: descriptive; the wording policy is a later researcher decision and no rung is dropped for wording sensitivity

item5_exemplars.basis: no WORDING_SENSITIVE rung: the largest-spread rungs are shown instead (all CONSISTENT or UNRESOLVED)

model_frame_variation.reading: modelling the frame (a random or fixed frame term in ι) is supported when τ² is a non-trivial share of the total variance and the spreads reproduce across the splits, but no single frame is the culprit

retain_all_frames.reading: if nearly every rung is CONSISTENT, τ is small next to the SE, and no sensitive rung replicates on both splits or touches the reference set, pooling the four frames as one instrument (v7's reading of §7.8) is supported by this pilot

retain_specified_subset.reading: a subset is supported only if one (or two) frames are the resolved outlier on many rungs with one sign, and that outlier status replicates on both splits; the per-frame ladders (Gate 2 ladders_by_frame_pooled) say whether the remaining frames still carry the ladder
